the failure is in src/pricing.py:15-22: invoice_total
qty and never applies the per-line "discount" key, so it charges full price (45.00
+ tax = 49.50) where the test expects discounted lines (30.00 + 5.00 = 35.00 + tax = 38.50). The
module's own docstring ("line discounts first, then tax") confirms the test is the correct
so the code gets fixed, not the test. line_total already implements the per-line
discount logic correctly, so invoice_total should build on it:
